features.name: op_expresses_fear_of_rejection_or_isolation
features.definition: Does the OP's argument explicitly express the OP's own fear of social rejection or isolation?
features.spec: Read only the argument text (OP's body). Return 1 if the OP, in their own assertions (not merely quoted others' words unless adopted), explicitly states fear, worry or dread of being rejected, ostracized, excluded, abandoned, disliked by others, or isolated/lonely as a consequence of their view or of changing it. Return 0 otherwise, including when the OP merely states beliefs. Ignore any OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome edits or reports of the outcome as evidence. Empty or missing argument gives null.

h0: Among arguments, op_expresses_fear_of_rejection_or_isolation is not associated with the view-change (delta) rate.
h1: Arguments with op_expresses_fear_of_rejection_or_isolation=1 have lower view-change rates than those without.
note: Operational assumption: the comparison group is all arguments lacking explicit fear of rejection/isolation (including those stating beliefs plainly); "emotional self-defense" is not separately measured, so the contrast is fear vs. not-fear rather than fear vs. belief-only without any emotion. Argument text is current and may contain edits or outcome announcements (excluded from the semantic judgment, but the text is not guaranteed pre-outcome). Association only.
